purpose: Bare probe comparing full-frame FLIP_DISCARD for HWND surfaces against the preceding FLIP_SEQUENTIAL ten-frame probe. DirectComposition remains sequential.
profile: debug, ten steady frames plus existing resize/idle sequence; foreground unchanged; AQUA_D3D11_PREVENT_THREADING=1.
conclusion: No GPU allocation improvement is observed, so no Editor implementation or default change is justified.
limits: One grouped debug probe comparison, not an Editor scoreboard or latency comparison.
The probe renders full frames and presents no dirty rectangles. An Editor implementation would need to disable partial rendering for discard surfaces; no such change was made.
Timing and CPU figures from this background-waiting probe are not performance evidence.
Results do not establish general equivalence on every DXGI driver.
